releaseNotes: Froze adapter contract A (layering plan phase A1, requirement R1). The boundary report and the import boundary report now carry contractVersion (core/adapters/contract.ts, 1.0.0 with named bump rules), validate their OWN output against new JSON Schemas (core/schema/boundary-report.schema.json, import-boundary-report.schema.json) before printing — an invalid report is never emitted — and the platform consumer accepts a report only on contract-major match, answering incompatibility as unreachable-with-reason rather than interpreting it. check:adapter-contract gates golden samples trimmed from real emissions: positives must validate at the declared version, negative controls must be refused (the detector proving it detects), and a code-version bump without regenerated goldens fails — the bump discipline made mechanical. Watched failing before its first green.

Fixed the slug divergence the 2026-08-19 audit named: platform slug() emitted underscores while the engine workspace resolver requires ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$, so every multi-word company name resolved to an unexplained unreachable. The platform now mints hyphenated slugs, and platform/server/test/contract.test.mjs pins both halves — every minted slug satisfies the engine rule, diacritics and padding included. The four founder decisions of the layering plan are recorded in the plan document, and the north star notes npm publish as deliberately deferred to git-tag pinning.
